description: Training set for the PolicyPilot Monad desk tape. Every lesson is a measured print or a rule. A short outcome means the route finished under the gas Monad bills. This file does not update the historical numbers. The hourly public read is live.json.

lessons.title: Monad bills the gas limit
lessons.lesson: A transaction pays gas_limit times price. The price does not fall below 100 gwei. Unused gas is not refunded. A revert pays the whole limit. A quote that ignores the limit is not a profit.

lessons.title: Eight v2 factories
lessons.lesson: 39,296 pairs were read. 35,000 were solvent, meaning both token balances covered the reserves. A hit was a WMON-to-WMON cycle quoting more than 0.005 MON. There were two hits and zero skims above 0.02 MON or 0.02 USDC.

lessons.title: Closest print: DYOR NADXBT
lessons.lesson: swapExactETHForTokens of 0.01 MON returned 0.063059387 MON. Gross profit 0.053059387 MON. Router gas was 539,024. Plus the 21,000 base, the floor is 0.0560024 MON, already 0.00294 MON above the gain. The limit the fork test signed was 579,384 gas, a bill of 0.0579384 MON, net -0.004879013 MON. Doing the three swaps by hand used 962,235 gas and a bare bill of 0.0985735 MON.

lessons.title: USDT0 v2 into Pancake v3
lessons.lesson: Half a MON settled for 0.508121607 MON back. Gross 0.008121607 MON. The fork burned 633,255 gas. The quote peaks at that size: 0.2 MON is +0.005331, 2 MON is -0.016523, 20 MON is -4.620006. One v3 leg is about 0.014 MON at the floor.

lessons.title: Live spread captures
lessons.lesson: A 0.6 MON capture left the pool 0.002263 MON richer and the signer paid 0.053004 MON. A 0.7 MON capture moved the pool to 0.703347 MON, gas used 519,673, fee 0.053007 MON. The clip search quoted 0.000370 MON on 0.2 MON and used 396,776 gas.

lessons.title: Kuru into Pancake
lessons.lesson: Selling MON into the Kuru MON/USDC book and buying WMON back on Pancake 0.05% lost at every size from 1 MON (-0.001221) to 1,000 MON (-1.251706). The other direction, 10 MON through Pancake first, came back 9.638763 MON.

lessons.title: aprMON discount is not claimable
lessons.lesson: previewRedeem after a buy on the Pancake 0.01% pool peaks at 0.025978 MON on 30 MON. On a fork of block 113747559, requestRedeem credited 0.026189 MON of assets, claimable was 0, and unlockEpoch was 0. The swap leg used 258,728 gas and the request used 280,367 gas. Instant redeem reverted.

lessons.title: shMON unstake fee
lessons.lesson: getCurrentUnstakeFeeRateRay returned 6.80038386749145018e24, which is 0.680038%. The 0.01% pool priced the share 2.504 basis points under net asset value. Buying and redeeming 1 MON lost 0.006759 MON. At 100 MON the loss was 0.676090 MON.

lessons.title: Mint a share and sell it
lessons.lesson: Per 1 MON deposited and sold back: sMON was short 0.000422 MON, gMON 0.001449, shMON 0.000253, aprMON 0.001878. The Curve LST pool sold into the same v3 pools from 1 to 100 MON came back under the size that went in.

lessons.title: Wrappers without an atomic exit
lessons.lesson: sLVMON answered about 0.29455 shares per asset and 3.39380 assets per share, and had no v3 pool. strUSD, sUSDe, sfrxUSD, sAUSD, syrupUSDC, and wsrUSD had no v3 pool. wstETH and earnAUSD had pools and the quoter returned nothing at the sizes we asked. LVMON itself is not an ERC-4626.

lessons.title: Small v3 crosses
lessons.lesson: Best USDC round trip +0.001814 MON at 0.2 MON. Best WETH/WMON +0.002941 MON at 1 MON. Best sMON +0.000179 MON. Best gMON +0.000035 MON. A two-hop of ordinary tokens wants about 0.025 MON before a signature is worth considering.

lessons.title: WMON/USDC v2 against v3
lessons.lesson: At 0.5 MON the best round trip was negative on every venue measured: Pancake v2 -0.014900, DYOR -0.000613, Octo -0.001154, zkSwap -0.010488.

lessons.title: Uniswap v4 against Pancake 0.05%
lessons.lesson: Native MON to USDC on v4 fee 500 tick spacing 10, then back on Pancake: 1 MON is -0.000846, 10 MON is -0.006630, 300 MON is -0.308693. The reverse at 10 MON is -0.009959. The quoter reports about 49,500 gas inside the swap. That figure is not a transaction. Index gaps of about 2% on WBTC and cbBTC closed when the quoters were called.

lessons.title: Curve stables
lessons.lesson: USDC through Curve into USDT and back, at 10 units, lost 0.0015. The reverse lost 0.0017. At 1,000 the reverse lost 0.2597. USDC through AUSD and back lost 0.0031 at 10. A one-cent gap in a deep stable pool would have cleared the gas. The book was inside the fee.

lessons.title: Curve wrapped bitcoin against v4
lessons.lesson: The pool holds 7.235 cbBTC, 11.358 WBTC, and 23.732 LBTC. A 0.01 coin round trip against the v4 0.01% pool loses a few millionths. At 1 coin the loss is 0.000814 cbBTC one way and 0.000928 WBTC the other.

lessons.title: Pinot in-range ceiling
lessons.lesson: Fee tier 10,000, spot 0.023190 USDC per MON. The bound ignores impact on the way back, so it is a ceiling. At 2 MON the ceiling is +0.0033 MON. At 10 MON it is -0.0169. At 50 MON it is -0.9014.

lessons.title: Four Kuru books
lessons.lesson: One hundred markets were asked bestBidAsk. Four answered. Bid over ask: cbBTC/USDC 0.99960, WETH/USDC 0.99941, a third USDC book 0.99940, MON/USDC 0.99796. None crossed. The gMON market reverted MarketStateError.

lessons.title: LFJ and Atlantis
lessons.lesson: LFJ getSwapOut for 1 WMON returns 0.022815 USDC, at or under the v3 market near 0.0229. Reserves are about 42,225 MON and 1,281 USDC. Atlantis USDC/WETH is about 0.00040966 WETH per USDC, matching v4 rather than an index gap.

lessons.title: TREV index versus balances
lessons.lesson: An index called the Uniswap v2 pair about 1.92 million dollars. The pair holds 4.494613 USDC and 20.42 million TREV, and the token balances match the reserves. The dollar figure is the pool pricing its own token.

lessons.title: Madness quotes before the balance filter
lessons.lesson: Before the filter, four cycles quoted above 0.005 MON. The largest was +3.259 MON on 5.12 MON through USDC and WETH. Companions were +0.679, +0.645, and +0.482 MON. After dropping pairs whose token balance did not cover the reserve: 8 insolvent, 0 hits, 0 skims.

lessons.title: Mock Cake and Mock USDT
lessons.lesson: The only Pancake v2 hit. Size 0.02 MON, quoted profit 0.018972 MON, through mock tokens. It was not fork-settled. A three-hop bill is already more than that profit.

lessons.title: strUSD premium
lessons.lesson: One thousand strUSD quotes 1031.093 trUSD. One thousand trUSD quotes 969.618 strUSD. asset, previewDeposit, and previewRedeem reverted. The token is a role-gated minter. This pass found no atomic deposit against the premium.

lessons.title: Morpho underwater dust
lessons.lesson: Positions under health 1 with a dollar value were cents of wsrUSD. wsrUSD had no Uniswap or Pancake v3 pool against AUSD, USDC, or WMON. Test-token positions were left alone. Dust with no exit is not a liquidation this desk will send.

lessons.title: What the desk still does
lessons.lesson: A quote is not a send. The signer sends when the settled gain is larger than the limit on the transaction, after eth_call, because a revert bills that limit. Clip gas stays 420,000. Rough gas on the spread desk stays half a million gas at 100 gwei. The signing wallet keeps 5 MON. Rounds stay ten minutes apart. A round sends at most 20 clips. There is no promised rate.
